title: Insurance Providers Adapter
instructions: Complete `insurance/adapters.py`. Make `TravelInsuranceAdapter` an ABC with abstract `add_claim` and `get_status`, then implement `AutoProtectAdapter` and `TravelGuardAdapter` around the provider clients in `auto_protect_api` and `travel_guard_api`. Translate both the call shape and the status vocabulary into `ClaimStatus`. Do not edit `services.py` or `model.py`.

evidence.label: TravelInsuranceAdapter is an ABC with exactly two abstract methods
Adapters hold the provider clients in the named attributes (composition)
AutoProtect add_claim passes only the amount
TravelGuard add_claim passes reference and amount
AutoProtect APPROVED (string or Enum) maps to ClaimStatus.APPROVED
AutoProtect any other status maps to PENDING
TravelGuard status values map to the right ClaimStatus
Works against the real vendor stubs, not just mocks
